name: Yuri Petrov
source:
Stern Bild City’s Administration of Justice’s judge as well as the TV heroes' curator. He is also Lunatic, a vigilante NEXT who can generate blue and green flames more powerful than Fire Emblem's. Lunatic is obsessed with justice and order; he believes in cleansing the world of evil by murdering criminals and wrongdoers rather than protecting the public, and questions the effectiveness of heroes.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Tiger_%26_Bunny_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
